items.title: Adobe appoints new CEO to succeed Narayen in December
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) executive Anil Chakravarthy has been chosen to succeed CEO Shantanu Narayen, starting in his chief executive role this December with Narayen becoming executive chair. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick to discuss the details of Adobe's succession plans.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is 'playing both sides' of AI with Hugging Face purchase
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is buying AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in a move that could extend Nvidia's reach in the AI ecosystem beyond being just a chip supplier. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman reacts to this headline news and what the acquisition of Hugging Face represents for Nvidia's growing market share of the AI landscape.

items.title: How Far AMD Stock Can Swing In Its Calm Case
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) trades at about $456.16, and its option chain has already put numbers on how far the stock can travel from here. Over roughly the next 380 days that chain marks out a band running from $260 to $792.23. The width is what matters if you hold the shares. That is the risk you are carrying, whichever way it breaks.
